crossRefs.note: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…
Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and…
He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he who loves abundance, with increase: this also is vanity.
Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will…
So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”
Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s…
